name: agentics-kit
description: Agentics plugin kit — developer tools, code review, planning, and CLAUDE.md optimization

metadata.description: Agentics plugin kit — developer tools, code review, planning, and CLAUDE.md optimization

plugins.name: memory-tools
plugins.description: Audit and optimize CLAUDE.md project memory files against Claude Code best practices

plugins.name: code-review
plugins.description: Structured multi-dimensional code review across quality, bugs, security, best practices, complexity rating, breaking changes, and regressions

plugins.name: plan-interview
plugins.description: Stress-test implementation plans with structured multi-round interviews before coding begins — auto-routes product plans to the panel review skill, always emits an interview HTML artifact

plugins.name: wcag-compliance-reviewer
plugins.description: Review HTML/CSS and React/TypeScript code for WCAG 2.2 Level AA accessibility compliance

plugins.name: skill-reviewer
plugins.description: Review and optimize Claude Code skill files — score SKILL.md quality, plan and scaffold new skills, audit allowed-tools permissions, optimize frontmatter (descriptions + disable-model-invocation), and enforce the three-part 200-char description format

plugins.name: code-testing-agent
plugins.description: Analyze code and suggest specific, purpose-driven tests tied to actual behavior and intent — not arbitrary coverage

plugins.name: git-agent
plugins.description: Automated git workflow — create branches, commit with conventional messages, and create PRs (with background subagents and slash commands for fire-and-forget commit, PR, and ship)

plugins.name: agent-creator
plugins.description: Scaffold Claude Code agent-based plugins with guided workflows

plugins.name: react-perf-analyzer
plugins.description: Identifies React component source patterns that commonly correlate with poor Event Timing (INP), Layout Instability (CLS), Long Animation Frames, and Long Tasks scores — produces a heuristic report with recommendations

plugins.name: marketplace-builder
plugins.description: Evaluate a repository and scaffold Claude Code skill marketplace infrastructure — audit readiness, generate missing files, and guide marketplace setup

plugins.name: agentic-plugin-dev
plugins.description: Create, manage, and validate Claude Code plugins — scaffold new plugins, manage marketplace entries, and audit plugin structure

plugins.name: code-simplifier
plugins.description: Analyze code for structural quality issues, code smells, and optimization opportunities — dead code, complexity, god classes, duplication, coupling, and performance anti-patterns

plugins.name: agent-reviewer
plugins.description: Review and audit Claude Code subagent definition files (agents/*.md) against official best practices — score frontmatter, tool configuration, description quality, system prompt quality, and security posture

plugins.name: product-plans
plugins.description: Improve, optimize, and update product plans, PRDs, and feature proposals using a cross-functional Agent Team (PM, Lead Developer, UX, Frontend, Accessibility, Security) — produces a 15-section consolidated report, applies improvements to the source plan, and appends findings to any existing plan-interview HTML artifact

plugins.name: settings-sync
plugins.description: Back up and restore Claude Code user settings to a dedicated git repo — routine-compatible for automated backups

plugins.name: code-share
plugins.description: Discover shareable code, blog posts, videos, GitHub snippets, selected code, and session recaps — scrub for secrets, draft objective-driven platform-aware copy, and generate styled dark-mode social cards for LinkedIn, Twitter/X, and Bluesky

plugins.name: plan-agent
plugins.description: Plan creation on demand — explicit /plan-agent:planning skill runs the full §0–§7 workflow from a free-text objective; filename validation hook enforces verb-target kebab-case on every plan write

plugins.name: issue-agent
plugins.description: Create GitHub and GitLab issues from any context — selection, session, bug, or feature — with host auto-detection and a confirmation gate before writing
